ecg.axis: normal in mild disease, right axis when pulmonary pressure rises
changes: Broad notched P waves of left atrial enlargement in sinus rhythm

Mild forward stroke volume stays above 75 ml
Moderate mean left atrial pressure 12 to 16 mmHg
Moderate forward stroke volume 65 to 75 ml
Severe mean left atrial pressure above 15 mmHg
Severe forward stroke volume below 62 ml
Severe rhythm is atrial fibrillation with no P waves
Severe ventricular rate 85 to 95 per min
